title: Admin clears a cash payment
description: Open Payment Log, filter to Pending cash rows, Clear one payment, and confirm it becomes Paid so the member can check in.

steps.title: Admin home
steps.body: Administrators use the Admin menu for Payment Log, Attendance Log, Plans, and System Configuration.

steps.title: Open Payment Log
steps.body: Payment Log lists every club payment — pending cash waiting at the desk, plus paid cash and online rows.

steps.title: Mixed Paid and Pending
steps.body: The seeded log shows several Paid rows (online test and cash) and a couple of unconfirmed cash payments with Clear / Reject.
steps.resultNote: Pending cash stays unpaid until an admin Clears it.

steps.title: Show Pending only
steps.body: Turn off Paid under Status so only unconfirmed cash payments remain. Leave Pending checked.

steps.title: Pending cash queue
steps.body: Only Pending cash rows remain — each has Clear and Reject. These members paid at the desk but the plan is not active yet.
steps.resultNote: Paid filter off; Pending filter on.

steps.title: Clear a cash payment
steps.body: Clear confirms the cash was received, marks the row Paid, and grants the plan on the payment.

steps.title: Payment cleared — member can check in
steps.body: That row is now Paid and the plan is active. The member should be able to check in (for example in check-in kiosk) with their new entitlement.
steps.resultNote: Clear grants the plan immediately; remaining Pending cash still waits for Clear or Reject.
